The whole 2027 calendar→

Group ride or organized ride?

A group ride is free and happens every week from the same spot: a shop, a café, a park. No sign-up. You show up and ride. We list 1422 of them in 19 countries, and every one says when it was last checked at its source.

An organized ride has a date, a sign-up and usually a fee or a fundraising minimum: charity rides, gran fondos, centuries, gravel races, multi-day tours. The 2027 calendar has 640 of them across the US, and says which dates the organizer has published.

I’m riding 6 of those in 2027 as part of the 10,000 miles. Come ride one, or pledge a mile.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, every one of them for queer communities. You pledge a few cents a mile and pick which org it goes to. It starts January 1.
